Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
In message <beh14j$im7$1...@nsnmrro2-gest.nuria.telefonica-data.net>,

Smiling Tom <t...@almadrava.net> writes:
>Pass the free states with the Power structure, and Gratiano (He only gets
>one vote in the prisci subreferendum, right? so the prisci block votes are
>still 3 votes towards this referendum)

Correct.

Free States Rant makes titles worth 1 less vote. So Gratiano's vote *as
a Priscus* is reduced by 1, to zero.

Gratiano's additional vote is *not* a title, nor related to his title.
(Even if he's made into an Archbishop or Regent or similar, he can still
cast it. Even if he changes clan/sect.) So that is still worth 1 vote
in the Prisci sub-referendum.

The Prisci block vote does not come from a title itself. So that is
still worth 3 votes.

--

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Colin McGuigan wrote:
> reyda wrote:

>> If someone has an aditionnal vote in any referendum, he is free to cast
>> them.
>
> Huh. Could I tap the Ventrue Headquarters for votes in the priscus
> sub-referendum? Play surprise influence?

No. The Ventrue Headquarters doesn't give any additional votes in the sub-referendum
It gives three votes in the main referendum. If you use it, you are free to cast
the votes you gain in the main referendum in the main referendum. (card text)

Likewise Surprise Influence. (card text)

Only Prisci votes can be used in the sub-referendum. [6.3.3]

Other votes can be used in the sub-referendum if allowed by explicit
card text (like Gratiano's). [1.4]


